text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka has asked me to assist
her with her
dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer? Could you cheer for me?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's just... I'm still not used to dancing in
front of
crowds.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay during races because I'm so
focused on
running, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Concerts are a different story. That's
why I want
you to cheer me on as loud as
you can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do as she asks, cheering her on as she
dances.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for coming today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I hope that you enjoy the concert just as
much as
the race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: W-with that said...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I just can't concentrate. What should I
do?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I just can't concentrate. What should I
do?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're right... There will be even more
people at
a real performance.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for stopping so suddenly. Let's
try again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Errr... Where was I? Oh, right... So,
please enjoy
the first song—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hm? Over where?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a bit of struggle, Silence Suzuka
manages to
complete her performance
even with my cheers
ringing in her ears. I
think she's ready for the real
thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest she try responding to the
crowd in
moments when she can't keep
focus.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I see. I'll try it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. That's me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I hope you all enjoy the concert.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew... How was that?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, right...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka manages to complete
both her
song and dance. I can't wait for
her next winning
concert.
